tool_args.rationale: The existing observations show a sharp high-gradient decline and sign crossing, while the tested static branch family failed fresh confirmation. A fine trajectory batch is the remaining informative probe to distinguish horizon-dependent dynamics from a different stationary response before deciding whether to abstain.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit the sink-modulated siphon with a negative square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both variants were already tested and fresh confirmation strongly refuted the fitted family (RMSE 0.509254 vs tolerance 0.045).
It is explicitly irrelevant and costly.
The result refutes the tested family, not all stationary mechanisms; a trajectory batch can test whether horizon dependence is important.
